benefits.title: Fill your calendar
benefits.description: Get in front of more clients looking for what you offer. They can see your availability and book in minutes, so there are fewer gaps in your week.

benefits.title: Reach clients across the UK
benefits.description: You are listed on a UK-wide marketplace, so new clients can find you by style, area and date, not only through the people who already follow you.

benefits.title: A profile that shows off your work
benefits.description: Your own shareable page with your portfolio, services, prices, reviews and policies. Attach the link to your socials and let it do the explaining.

benefits.title: Less admin, more hair
benefits.description: No more back-and-forth in your DMs. Clients choose a service, pick a time and pay in one go, and automatic email and SMS reminders keep them on track.

benefits.title: Protect your income
benefits.description: Take deposits or full payment upfront with secure card payments. Set your own cancellation window and late or no-show fees, so a no-show does not cost you.

benefits.title: Run it your way
benefits.description: Set your own services, prices, hours and policies. Add options like size and length, block out time off and decide how clients book you.

benefits.title: Know how your business is doing
benefits.description: See bookings, takings and insights in one place. Track what is earning, export statements and plan your next month with real numbers.
